title_zh: 央行公布11月LPR：两种利率和上个月一样
title_en: PBOC releases November LPR: both rates are the same as last month

paragraphs.zh: 11月20日上午9点，中国人民银行公布了新一期的贷款市场报价利率，也就是LPR。这次，1年期的LPR是3.0%，5年期以上的LPR是3.5%。
paragraphs.en: At 9 a.m. on November 20, the People's Bank of China released the new loan prime rate, also called the LPR. This time, the 1-year LPR is 3.0% and the LPR for 5 years and above is 3.5%.

paragraphs.zh: 这两个数字和10月的一样，没有上调，也没有下调。去年11月，这两种利率也是3.0%和3.5%。
paragraphs.en: These two numbers are the same as in October: they were neither raised nor cut. In November last year, these two rates were also 3.0% and 3.5%.

paragraphs.zh: LPR是银行给贷款定价时要参考的利率，每个月20日由全国银行间同业拆借中心发布，遇到节假日就往后推。一般来说，企业贷款和个人消费贷款多参考1年期LPR，而房贷多参考5年期以上LPR。
paragraphs.en: The LPR is the rate banks refer to when they price loans. It is released by the National Interbank Funding Center on the 20th of each month, and is moved later when that day falls on a holiday. Generally speaking, company loans and personal consumer loans mostly refer to the 1-year LPR, while home loans mostly refer to the LPR for 5 years and above.

paragraphs.zh: 央行的公告说，这次的LPR在下一次公布之前都有效。下一次LPR将在12月公布。
paragraphs.en: The central bank's announcement said this LPR stays valid until the next one is released. The next LPR will be released in December.

People's Bank of China (China's central bank)
quoted price; to quote a price
to lower, to cut (a rate or price)
to set a price, to price

vocab.hanzi: 全国银行间同业拆借中心
vocab.pinyin: Quánguó Yínháng Jiān Tóngyè Chāijiè Zhōngxīn

featured.note: Common collocations: 下调利率 / 上调利率 (cut / raise rates), 存款利率 (deposit rate), 贷款利率 (lending rate), 利率不变 (rates unchanged).

examples.zh: 央行这个月没有下调利率。
examples.py: Yāngháng zhège yuè méiyǒu xiàtiáo lìlǜ.
examples.en: The central bank did not cut interest rates this month.

examples.zh: 我想把钱存在利率高一点的银行。
examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng bǎ qián cún zài lìlǜ gāo yìdiǎn de yínháng.
examples.en: I want to keep my money in a bank with a slightly higher interest rate.

examples.zh: 现在房贷利率比五年前低了很多。
examples.py: Xiànzài fángdài lìlǜ bǐ wǔ nián qián dī le hěn duō.
examples.en: Mortgage rates are now much lower than five years ago.

featured.en: loan; to take out or grant a loan
featured.note: As a noun: 企业贷款 (business loans), 消费贷款 (consumer loans), 申请贷款 (apply for a loan), 还贷款 (repay a loan); as a verb: 向银行贷款 (borrow from a bank).

examples.zh: 这家银行今年给小企业的贷款增加了不少。
examples.py: Zhè jiā yínháng jīnnián gěi xiǎo qǐyè de dàikuǎn zēngjiā le bù shǎo.
examples.en: This bank's loans to small businesses grew quite a lot this year.

examples.zh: 他们向银行贷款买了一套房子。
examples.py: Tāmen xiàng yínháng dàikuǎn mǎi le yí tào fángzi.
examples.en: They took out a bank loan to buy an apartment.

examples.zh: 我们发现，用手机申请贷款的用户越来越多。
examples.py: Wǒmen fāxiàn, yòng shǒujī shēnqǐng dàikuǎn de yònghù yuè lái yuè duō.
examples.en: We found that more and more users apply for loans on their phones.
